draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Palolem! The beach is a mile-long crescent with rocks at both ends, and the sea slopes so gently that you can walk up to 100 m out from the shore.
draft.hungryLine: Fishing is one of the two big trades here, so your fish dinner really is from the sea, and Fernandes near the church is a favourite with old regulars.

moodReplies.show-me-around: At low tide, walk across the rocks to Butterfly Island on the right end of the beach, or ride the coastal road north to Agonda and Cabo da Rama.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Grab one of the free sun loungers with an umbrella on the beach, or take a boat to tiny Honeymoon Beach for total quiet.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Butterfly Beach, a boat ride away, is so steep you can dive in right from the water's edge if you time it well.

spots.name: Agonda beach
spots.detail: 20 km north · A very quiet beach along a beautiful coastal road

spots.name: Cabo da Rama
spots.detail: Further north past Agonda · A ruined fort on a cliff with big views

spots.name: Cotigao wildlife sanctuary
spots.detail: Good day trip · A wildlife sanctuary in Canacona

legends.title: The sage Kanva
legends.body: Some traditional accounts link this region with the name Kanvapur and the sage Kanva. Goa University calls it one of several traditions about where the name Kankon came from.

tips.title: Take the boat at 7AM or 5PM.
tips.body: Early morning or around 5PM is the best time for the island boat ride, and the evening one gets you the sunset.

tips.title: Watch the tide for Butterfly Island.
tips.body: You can only walk across at low tide, so carry water and go carefully, as people have hurt themselves on those rocks.

story.title: Kingdom of Soonda
story.body: Canacona was one of the districts of the Kingdom of Soonda, itself a remnant of the Vijayanagara Empire. Its name is a corruption of Konkan.

story.title: Handed to Portugal
story.body: When Hyder Ali of Mysore invaded Soonda, the heirless Raja ceded the rest to Portugal. Canacona joined Goa in 1794.

story.title: Lightly Portuguese
story.body: Canacona's culture is an Indo-Portuguese mix, but it saw less Portuguese influence than the central Old Conquests of Goa.

story.title: Fishers and travellers
story.body: Palolem's shore is shared by local fishermen and foreign visitors who stay in shacks along the beach or in the village.

food.name: Fernandes
food.detail: Just past the church on the right side of the beach · Indian food, tandoori and fairly cheap fresh fish

food.name: Cool Breeze
food.detail: A jazz café popular with locals, with great food

food.name: Sameer Restaurant
food.detail: Right on the beach · Good breakfasts with ocean views
